skills.name: Knight's Oath
skills.description: Kneels and swears  to fight as a knight.  *Skill Use Rate +30% (10 sec) *Skill Hit Rate +30% (10 sec)

skills.name: Hadron Blaster
skills.description: Summons Lancelot Conquista.  Fires the Hadron Blaster.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Enemy Move Speed -40% (7 sec) *Enemy Skill Resistance -60% (7 sec) *ATK x 4700% Area Damage

abilities.name: Group: CODE GEASS Lelouch of the Rebellion
abilities.description: CODE GEASS Lelouch of the Rebellion Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle.  You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Stun: Agility
abilities.description: Has a high chance of stunning all Agility type enemies and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
